segments.zh: 我喜欢我的 Puma 鞋。

segments.en: And I love flat shoes.
And so when you buy a pair of shoes you really like, you don't want to buy another pair in six months.
segments.zh: 所以当你买一双你真正喜欢的鞋子时，你不想在六个月内再买一双。

segments.en: You want to get a pair that has a really good sole so that it will last for a long time.
segments.zh: 你想买一双鞋底非常好的鞋底，这样它就可以持续很长时间。

segments.en: Right, right.
Yeah, that's true.
I think for me, yeah, that's probably one of the most important parts is the sole, as long as it's comfortable.
segments.zh: 我认为，是的，这可能是最重要的部分之一，只要它是舒适的。

segments.en: Because some soles of some shoes can be very rigid.
segments.zh: 因为有些鞋子的鞋底可能很硬。

segments.en: Yeah.
So it's a little bit uncomfortable to walk with.
But I don't know.
I don't really have that many pairs of shoes if I think about it.
segments.zh: 如果我想一想，我真的没有那么多双鞋。

segments.en: Well, most people have one fancy pair of shoes for special occasions.
segments.zh: 好吧，大多数人在特殊场合都有一双精美的鞋子。

segments.en: And then a pair of work shoes that are leather.
segments.zh: 然后是一双皮革的工作鞋。

segments.en: And then maybe a couple pairs of sneakers and some sandals for the summer.
segments.zh: 然后可能是夏天的几双运动鞋和一些凉鞋。

segments.en: So you have sandals and you have flip flops.
segments.zh: 所以你有凉鞋，你有人字拖。

segments.en: Are they the same?
Well, sandals is basically a kind of shoe.
segments.zh: 嗯，凉鞋基本上是一种鞋子。

segments.en: It's an open shoe that you wear in the summer.
segments.zh: 这是你夏天穿的开放式鞋子。

segments.en: Flip flops are a kind of sandal.
So they usually have a V in the front.
segments.zh: 所以他们通常在前面有一个V。

segments.en: And that's where you put your big toe.
The second toe.
So we wear them in the shower or at the beach.
segments.zh: 所以我们在淋浴或海滩上穿它们。

segments.en: They're usually made of plastic or rubber so that you can get them wet.
segments.zh: 它们通常由塑料或橡胶制成，因此您可以将它们弄湿。

segments.en: But flip flops are a kind of sandal.
Very good.
It's very interesting how many styles and types of shoes.
segments.zh: 鞋子的款式和种类居然这么多，真有意思。

segments.en: And actually for men, I think it's not that complicated.
segments.zh: 实际上，对于男性来说，我认为这并不复杂。

segments.en: But when we get into women's shoes, then we'll see a lot of different things.
segments.zh: 但是当我们穿上女鞋时，我们会看到很多不同的东西。

segments.en: There are too many styles.
I can't keep track.
All right.
So that's all the time we have for today.
segments.zh: 好了，今天的节目就到这里。

segments.en: But we'll see you guys on the website if you have any questions, any doubts, or if you just want to chat with us.
segments.zh: 但是，如果您有任何问题、任何疑问，或者您只是想与我们聊天，我们会在网站上见到你们。

segments.zh: 我们将在 Englishpod.com 见到您。
